Game Overview

At its heart, Froggy Man is a adventure game about leap into the vibrant world of Froggy Man. As a daring green frog, master double jumps to devour flies while evading perilous orange frogs and obstacles. Navigate through eight escalating levels, uncover clever strategies, and reach the green flag to advance. Can you conquer this charming, challenging platformer adventure?
